text:
maria: heads-up: seeing an uptick in fncall validation failures on the canary route svc-chat-canary starting ~11:07 UTC — reject rate went from ~0.6% to ~3.9%
aj: any quick pattern?
sarah: grabbing samples now. short answer: some adapter outputs are arrays for `tool_response` while validator expects an object. validator error: `expected object, got array`
maria: this looks adapter-side. new adapter PR changed single-output marshalling to allow multi-result lists.
kevin: can you paste a sanitized sample?
sarah: sure, two sanitized examples below:
```json
{"req_id":"r-22","tool_response": []}
{"req_id":"r-23","tool_response": ["ok"]}
```
aj: that explains it. telemetry sampling for validation.rejects is low; we might be missing context.
maria: current sampling is 0.1% globally. canary-specific sampling not configured.
sarah: suggestion: bump canary sampling to 5% for 2 hours and tag samples with `adapter_mismatch=true` and `route_id`. we need trace links attached.
kevin: ops ask for clickable trace links in console not just counters. will wire that if samples include trace_id.
aj: we have two mitigations: 1) make validator lenient (coerce array->object when single element) behind a feature flag; 2) rollback canary to previous adapter. Which do we want?
maria: leaning to short-term lenient coercion so we can collect metrics, but worried it'll mask a broken adapter.
kevin: if we coerce we must mark those events as `coerced=true` so billing and analytics can filter. Re: billing: rejected fncalls currently don't count towards usage; soft-accept will affect charges. Need product/finance sign-off or a filter.
sarah: hybrid approach: accept with coercion but add `accepted_via_coercion=true` metadata, and emit meter event with `coercion_candidate` tag so finance can exclude in reports until approved.
aj: I can implement lenient path behind flag `fncall_coerce_canary_1810`. will add unit tests and a small e2e. PR in ~45m.
maria: infra changes needed:
- increase per-route sampling to 5% for svc-chat-canary (sarah)
- feature-flagged lenient validator (aj)
- metering flag `coercion_candidate` (kevin)
- console: sample links to traces + dashboard tile for `validation.reject_rate` vs `coerced_accept_rate` per route (sarah/UX)
- alert tweak: don't page on pre-coercion rejects, page on post-coercion failures > 2% (aj will update monitors)

kevin: I'll talk to finance to ensure they can exclude `coercion_candidate` events for now.
sarah: I'll wire the dashboard tile and make sample rows clickable to traces. filing UX ticket for a better per-canary telemetry panel: UX-2140.
aj: PR draft: https://git.internal/r/redwood/validator/pulls/501 (draft). includes migration to add `coercion` dimension to metering events.
maria: deploy-bot: can you set a temporary monitor that pages only if post-coercion rejects > 2% sustained for 10m?
deploy-bot: [info] monitor updated: canary svc-chat-canary — alert suppressed for pre-coercion rejects; paging enabled for post-coercion-reject_rate > 2% for 10m.
kevin: timeline estimate: sampling + metering flag in 45m, lenient validator PR merged in ~2h behind flag, enable coercion for 4h then evaluate metrics.
aj: will include a rollback note in PR description. if coerced_accept_rate > 10% or quality regression in evals, rollback.
sarah: linking sample set to PR so reviewers can see raw failing payloads and traces.
maria: agree. if anything spikes above 10% before we finish, we stop the canary. otherwise proceed with coercion and close the loop in 3-4h. :thumbsup:
kevin: pinged finance and set expectations. adding internal billing filter to ignore `coercion_candidate` events for the window.
sarah: dashboard draft: https://console.internal/d/telemetry/validation-canary-1810 (private)
aj: PR pushed to draft, requesting review from maria and kevin.
deploy-bot: [alert] svc-chat-canary at 5% traffic. validation.reject_rate currently 3.9%. will page if post-coercion-rejects exceed 2%.
maria: thanks. let's proceed carefully and document everything in the PR and the incident notes.
